headlines.text: It was 2024 when a new chapter began as Will Ospreay vs. MJF fought for the brand-new AEW American Title, appearing on All In: London, rated 8.54 ? a stone-cold classic. Ospreay overcame MJF's attempted brass-knuckles cheat ? foiled by a returning Daniel Garcia ? to hit the Tiger Driver '91 in front of his home London crowd, winning back the International Title.

Rewind to 2023, when QT Marshall vs. Gravity etched their names into history in the first-ever AAA Latin American Title match, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.18. QT Marshall retained his AAA Latin American Championship against Bandido's brother Gravity, closing the show out with a Dirt Sheet Driver despite mocking Gravity's family name beforehand.
2021 brought us this moment: Cezar Bononi was back in action after just under 5 months away, appearing on Dynamite.

secondaries.text: Turning the clock back to 2024: there was a changing of the guard for the AEW World Heavyweight Title as Bryan Danielson vs. Swerve Strickland battled it out, appearing on All In: London, rated 9.66 ? an all-time classic ? ending the champion's reign at 5 defenses. In a Title vs. Career match, Danielson survived Strickland's arsenal of finishers before locking in the LeBell Lock to win the AEW World Championship and save his career in front of 50,000 fans.

It was 2024 when the AEW Women's World Title had a new owner by the end of the night as Mariah May vs. Toni Storm battled it out, appearing on All In: London, rated 8.01 ? a genuinely great match ? ending the champion's reign at 8 defenses. For Mariah May, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. After a nine-month rivalry, May hit Storm's own Storm Zero finisher to dethrone her former mentor and become the new AEW Women's World Champion in an instant classic.

That Sunday in 2024, the AEW World Trios Titles had a new owner by the end of the night as Castagnoli, PAC & Yuta vs. The Patriarchy vs. House of Black vs. Gunns & Robinson battled it out in a Ladder match, appearing on All In: London, rated 7.10 ? a strong outing ? ending the champion's reign at 1 defense. For Castagnoli, PAC & Yuta, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. It marked House of Black's 10th match with the title on the line. In a four-way London Ladder match, PAC booted Killswitch off Christian Cage's shoulders to grab a title as Blackpool Combat Club dethroned The Patriarchy for the AEW World Trios Championship.
